reason: Workspace blast radius for the LawFirm OS CI Test Router Governance patch (v1): 22 protected files touched across five repos. The patch installs the central deterministic CI/test router owned by Semantic Substrate (new schemas, registries, governance doc, scripts, and tests) and a local ci-test-manifest.json in each runtime repo. Additionally, this same workspace change set includes the Orchestrator contracts.lock.json bump to substrate HEAD 590e18c (covered by its own file-scope decision record). The full surface is intentionally broad because the router is a workspace-level control plane; per the patch's APPLY_ORDER.md and README, it must land coherently across all five repos.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The user's continuation handoff after the initial router-patch validation explicitly required fixing two blockers and rerunning all validators against the updated workspace. The patch was applied non-destructively (every router file is an add; no protected file was overwritten without a backup) and the front-door manifests were extended to register the new schemas/registries/governance doc per the user's Blocker 1 instructions. The Orchestrator lock bump implements the user's Blocker 2 Option A. The blast radius decision records all of this as a coherent governance package and aligns with LawFirm OS architecture: Semantic Substrate owns central routing authority; runtime repos declare local inventory only.
diff_review_summary: 22 protected files in the working-tree blast radius for this patch session: (a) Semantic Substrate additions: docs/CI_TEST_ROUTER_ARCHITECTURE.md, governance/CI_TEST_ROUTING_BOUNDARY.md, schemas/ci-test-route-decision.schema.json, schemas/repo-ci-test-manifest.schema.json, schemas/test-artifact-metadata.schema.json, registry/ci-test-route-registry.json, registry/test-architecture-registry.json, registry/test-framework-adapter-registry.json, scripts/{route_ci_tests,validate_ci_route_decision,discover_test_artifacts,validate_test_artifact_registration,validate_new_repo_ci_onboarding,validate_contract_lock_drift_workspace}.py, tests/test_ci_test_routing.py, tests/test_test_artifact_registration.py, ci-test-manifest.json. (b) Semantic Substrate edits to extend front-door manifests: registry/schema-registry.json (3 CI router schema entries appended at end of array), registry/registry-full-manifest.json (3 CI router registry paths inserted in sorted positions), registry/governance-full-manifest.json (CI_TEST_ROUTING_BOUNDARY.md inserted in sorted position), governance/CI_TEST_ROUTING_BOUNDARY.md (cross-references section appended; original content preserved). (c) Each runtime repo: a new ci-test-manifest.json. (d) Orchestrator contracts.lock.json: three-field bump (covered by its own file decision record). (e) Orchestrator tests/test_cross_repo_contract.py and tests/test_classify_exception.py: SHA assertion updated from dfacbb5 to 590e18c to match the new lock. No protected content removed. No public symbols deleted. All governance keywords preserved.
